versions.changelog:
Version 0.7.3 introduces a major overhaul of crm-enrichment, converting it into a cookbook skill with modular enrichment pipelines for both accounts and contacts.

- Adds a fully documented CRM enrichment pipeline, supporting separate account and contact enrichment paths.
- Introduces new modular connectors, models, tools, and plays for both account and contact enrichment.
- Clarifies CRM-only use; instructs when to use alternate skills for lists or one-off lookups.
- Includes detailed instructions for adapting to different CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio) and for approving field contracts and deployments.
- Provides path-specific audit references, runtime instructions, and acceptance criteria.
- Removes old standalone instructions, shifting entirely to project-based usage and setup.

crm-enrichment 0.7.2

- Major cookbook revision: Introduced a flexible pipeline for CRM account and contact enrichment, replacing the old micro-skill.
- Added separate enrichment paths for accounts (companies) and contacts, each with its own data model, approval, and contract.
- Integrated LinkedIn and domain-based routes for company enrichment; added multi-step enrichment for contacts via LinkedIn and email resolution.
- Outputs: Only fills blank fields, ensures idempotency, and sets enrichment status stamps only after successful writes.
- Provided detailed setup, field mapping, and deployment/audit guides for integration with Cargo CDK projects.
- Added comprehensive documentation, configuration, and code references for consumer projects.

**CRM enrichment 0.7.1 — Major update with a new structured, adaptable CDK pipeline and expanded documentation.**

- Introduced modular account and contact enrichment pipelines for CRM records with configurable paths.
- Added detailed setup, audit, configuration, and run guides, including acceptance criteria and field contracts.
- Expanded support to HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, and Cargo CDK, clarifying provider dependencies and CRM targets.
- All resources and models refactored for compatibility with Cargo CDK; example does not directly read/write CRM until customized.
- New documentation and reference material: README, audit, configuration, contract, and evaluation files.
- Previous standalone package documentation replaced with a cookbook-style, project-adaptable approach.

**Major update: Project refactored with CDK pipeline, separate account and contact enrichment plays, and new tooling/contracts.**

- Introduces a Cargo CDK example with separate enrichment paths for CRM accounts and contacts.
- Adds modular infra: connectors, models, tools, and plays for account and contact enrichment.
- Contact pipeline chains 3 gated tools: Find Email, Find LinkedIn Profile from Email, and LinkedIn Enrichment.
- All business fields only fill blanks; CRM writes controlled and stamped after successful updates.
- Documentation split into audit, configuration, and run steps with detailed field contracts and acceptance criteria.
- Deprecated standalone instructions and removed legacy files; now requires adapting to consumer Cargo CDK projects.

crm-enrichment 0.6.4

- Major update: Migrated to a cookbook, field-contract-based enrichment play for CRM accounts, designed for deployment and audit-driven approval flows.
- Now works by extracting, mapping, and backfilling approved blank firmographics from LinkedIn, with auto-refresh on stale records (6+ months).
- Adds complete operator workflow: audit & recommend fields, approve build, review cost, run with detailed reporting and links.
- Stronger project integration: intended for use with Cargo CDK and requires cargo-cdk skill; no CRM write until agent adapts it.
- README, configuration, audit, and operations references added for clarity and deployment guidance.
- Outdated stand-alone implementation documentation removed.

crm-enrichment v0.5.1

- Major refresh: Skill is now a CDK-based deployable play, shifting focus from CLI recipes to automated CRM data hygiene via the Cargo platform.
- New full example and resources added, including sample CDK infra, rich documentation (README, audit/config references, acceptance criteria).
- Now supports refresh logic: Re-enrolls records after six months to keep crucial firmographics up to date, powered by LinkedIn.
- Strictly avoids overwriting existing data; only fills approved, operator-selected blanks.
- Extensive documentation to guide deployment/adaptation in consumer projects (not plug-and-play; requires agent review).
- Old standalone/CLI pattern and docs removed in favor of a modern, auditable CDK recipe.

**crm-enrichment 0.5.0**  
Major update: Migrated from CLI example to a deployable CRM enrichment play for Cargo CDK projects.

- Adds a worked Cargo CDK project example for automated CRM account enrichment and periodic refresh, including new infrastructure and reference files.
- Now fills approved blank firmographics from LinkedIn and re-enrolls stale records every six months, writing back to the CRM by record-id without overwriting filled fields.
- Compatibility updated: requires a Cargo CDK project and @cargo-ai/cdk ^1.0.51; does not deploy or access CRM until adapted in the consumer project.
- Expanded documentation with clear setup, adaptation, audit, and deployment instructions.
- Replaces previous standalone CLI snippets; removes `skill-card.md` and supersedes original instructions in `SKILL.md`.
- New file structure supporting adoption, including README, evaluation, audit reference, and configuration specifics.

Initial release of crm-enrichment standalone skill:

- Enriches empty fields on CRM records to improve routing, scoring, and territory assignment, powered by Cargo.
- Supports person, company, and funding enrichment, plus email finding, through batch CLI actions.
- Provides clear setup instructions; requires @cargo-ai/cli and Cargo account.
- Pricing is per enriched record with guidance on sampling before large runs.
- Includes best practices for cost management and data quality.
- Recommends using the full Cargo GTM pack for multi-step flows and additional GTM automation.
